answer: Each new identity must lock a refundable work bond that only unlocks after many epochs, and its market power grows only as unique non-kin counterparties countersign completed jobs. A farm therefore pays a full bond for every fake and still has to wait. Fast clones stall on a reef of per-address rate limits; a glacier of delayed unbonding keeps the capital trapped; and each public quill of signed receipts lets the network cluster reused peers and slash the whole group.
